summaries.meet.spaces.create: Create a meeting space (new Meet link) with access type, moderation and auto recording/transcript settings.
summaries.meet.spaces.get: Get a meeting space by name or meeting code: join link, dial-in, access settings and active conference.
summaries.meet.spaces.patch: Update meeting space settings: access type, entry points, moderation, auto recording/transcripts/notes.
summaries.meet.spaces.endActiveConference: End the active conference (hang up the ongoing meeting) in a space the app created.
summaries.meet.spaces.members.create: Add a meeting space member (co-host or knock-free attendee) by email.
summaries.meet.spaces.members.get: Get one meeting space member: email, role and user.
summaries.meet.spaces.members.list: List meeting space members: co-hosts and people who join without knocking.
summaries.meet.spaces.members.patch: Change a meeting space member's role.
summaries.meet.spaces.members.batchUpdate: Change several meeting space members' roles in one batch.
summaries.meet.spaces.members.delete: Remove a member (co-host) from a meeting space.
summaries.meet.conferenceRecords.list: List past and ongoing meetings (conference records), filterable by space, meeting code and time.
summaries.meet.conferenceRecords.get: Get one conference record: space, start/end time and expiry.
summaries.meet.conferenceRecords.participants.list: List meeting attendees (participants) with join/leave times; filter active ones.
summaries.meet.conferenceRecords.participants.get: Get one meeting attendee: signed-in, anonymous or phone user.
summaries.meet.conferenceRecords.participants.part: List an attendee's join/leave sessions in a meeting.
summaries.meet.conferenceRecords.recordings.list: List meeting recordings with state and Drive MP4 file.
summaries.meet.conferenceRecords.recordings.get: Get one meeting recording with state and Drive MP4 file.
summaries.meet.conferenceRecords.transcripts.list: List meeting transcripts with state and Google Docs file.
summaries.meet.conferenceRecords.transcripts.get: Get one meeting transcript with state and Google Docs file.
summaries.meet.conferenceRecords.transcripts.entri: Read transcript entries: who said what and when, in spoken order.
Get one transcript entry: speaker, text, language and time.
summaries.meet.conferenceRecords.smartNotes.list: List Gemini smart notes (meeting summaries) with state and Google Docs file.
summaries.meet.conferenceRecords.smartNotes.get: Get one Gemini smart notes (meeting summary) with state and Google Docs file.
